title: Spring constant calculation
description: Essential: Correctly applies Hooke's law to compute k = F_spring / Δx, yielding 250 N/m.

title: Friction on A from B
description: Essential: Correctly identifies the static friction force on block A as equal to the rope tension, giving 5√3 N with correct direction.

title: Friction on B from ground
description: Essential: Correctly computes the ground friction on B from horizontal force balance, giving (5√3)/2 N with correct direction.

title: Force equilibrium for C
description: Important: Sets up correct equilibrium equations for ball C to find spring force (5 N) and rope tension (5√3 N).

title: Force equilibrium for A
description: Important: Recognizes that the only horizontal force on A is the friction from B, balancing the rope tension.

title: Force equilibrium for B
description: Important: Applies horizontal equilibrium to B, considering friction from ground and horizontal components from rope/spring.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Converts Δx from cm to m correctly and maintains consistent units throughout.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Assigns incorrect sign or direction to friction forces (e.g., wrong horizontal component).

title: Angle misuse
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect trigonometric functions (sin vs cos) for force components from given angles.
